audit.summary: 2 critical P1 vulnerabilities and 6 high P2 vulnerabilities require immediate action. Supply chain risk across 641 total dependencies.

findings.title: Vitest UI Server RCE
findings.description: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary files can be read and executed without authorization. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this to achieve remote code execution.
findings.impact: Arbitrary code execution on developer machines and CI environments

findings.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection (Critical)
findings.description: Multiple JavaScript injection vulnerabilities via AST Type Confusion. Attackers can craft malicious template inputs that execute arbitrary code.
vulnerabilities: Template injection via AST type confusion
Denial of service via malformed decorators
findings.impact: Template injection attacks, arbitrary code execution
fix_steps: Run: npm ls handlebars (identify dependency chain)

findings.title: Vite Path Traversal & FS Bypass
findings.description: Multiple vulnerabilities: server.fs.deny bypass on Windows, path traversal in optimized deps, NTLMv2 hash disclosure via UNC path handling.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated read access to source code, environment files, secrets, credential disclosure
findings.note: Major version update from 5.x to 8.x required; review release notes

findings.title: UUID Buffer Overflow
findings.description: Missing buffer bounds check in UUID v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter is provided. Attacker can trigger buffer overflow with smaller buffer than expected.
findings.impact: Potential arbitrary code execution, memory corruption, application crash
findings.note: Major version update (9.x to 11.x); test UUID generation thoroughly

findings.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection
findings.description: Multipart form field names and filenames are not properly escaped, allowing CRLF injection. Attacker can inject arbitrary HTTP headers.
findings.impact: HTTP response splitting, cache poisoning, session fixation, XSS via header injection

findings.title: React Router Open Redirect
findings.description: Same-origin redirect with path starting with // is reinterpreted as protocol-relative URL, allowing open redirect attacks.
findings.impact: Phishing attacks, malware distribution, session hijacking

findings.title: JS-YAML DoS Attack
findings.description: YAML merge-key chains can force quadratic CPU consumption. Specially crafted inputs cause exponential-time expansion.
findings.impact: Application unresponsiveness, resource exhaustion, service unavailability
findings.note: Verify YAML parsing is not done on user input

findings.title: WebSocket Memory Exhaustion DoS
findings.description: Memory exhaustion from tiny fragments and data chunks. Attacker sends fragmented WebSocket frames to exhaust server memory.
findings.impact: Server memory exhaustion, crash/restart, denial of service
findings.note: Consider adding frame size limits in WebSocket config

findings.title: Express Query Parser DoS
findings.note: Current version 4.18.2 is not in vulnerable range; monitor for future updates

findings.title: Body Parser Denial of Service
findings.description: Invalid limit value silently disables size enforcement. Malformed limit option bypasses size checks.
findings.impact: Bypass of request size limits, potential DoS, memory exhaustion

findings.title: Brace Expansion DoS
findings.description: DoS via exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups. Malformed glob patterns cause process hang.
findings.impact: Process hang, memory exhaustion, service unavailability

findings.title: QS Query String DoS
findings.description: qs.stringify() crashes on null/undefined entries in comma-format arrays with encodeValuesOnly=true.
findings.impact: Application crash on malformed input, denial of service

findings.title: PostCSS XSS
findings.description: Unescaped </style> in CSS Stringify output. User-provided CSS may contain unescaped style tags.
findings.impact: XSS in generated CSS, payload injection

findings.title: Babel Core File Read
findings.description: Arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL comment. Specially crafted source map URLs can read arbitrary files.
findings.impact: Unauthorized file access, source code/config disclosure

findings.title: Vitest Transitive Issues
transitive_issues: Depends on Vite with path traversal issues (DEP-003)
Depends on esbuild with dev server CSRF vulnerability (DEP-016)
Depends on @vitest/mocker with transitive vite issues
findings.note: Fixes primary RCE (DEP-001); verify transitive deps after update

findings.title: ESBuild Development Server CSRF
findings.description: Development server allows any website to send requests and read responses. Cross-origin requests to dev server exfiltrate data.
findings.impact: Source code disclosure, environment variable exposure, CSRF during development
findings.note: Use dev servers in isolated environments; update vite

findings.title: Express 2 Major Versions Behind
findings.recommendation: Update to 4.22.2 for security patches; plan Express 5.x migration

findings.title: Pino 2 Major Versions Behind
findings.recommendation: Update to Pino 10.x for latest features and security patches

findings.title: UUID 5 Major Versions Behind
findings.note: Also has buffer overflow CVE (DEP-004); requires update to 11.x+

findings.title: React 1 Major Version Behind
findings.recommendation: Monitor React 19; consider migration after stabilization

findings.title: React Router 1 Major Version Behind
findings.note: Also has open redirect CVE (DEP-006); requires update to 6.30.4+
